headline: Sensex and Nifty turn red after positive start; IT stocks drag while NSE IPO sees strong demand

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: IT stocks extended declines, putting pressure on the benchmark indices during the session
Markets pared early gains despite cooling crude oil prices and a positive opening
Investor caution prevailed amid F&O expiry and mixed global market signals from Asian peers
Brent crude prices falling below $100 initially helped sentiment before volatility took over
whatHappening: Nifty 50 slipped below the 23,300 mark, snapping its four-day gaining streak
The NSE IPO reached a 6x subscription level on its final day of bidding
Parag Milk Foods is investing ₹100 crore to boost its paneer production capacity
DGCA is reviewing SpiceJet's finances amid ongoing financial scrutiny of the airline
summary: Indian markets opened higher on Tuesday but turned volatile, with the Nifty slipping below 23,300 as IT stocks faced selling pressure. The NSE IPO witnessed strong investor interest with 6x subscription on its final day. Corporate highlights include Parag Milk Foods' expansion plans and regulatory scrutiny on SpiceJet's finances.
